hypothesis.statement: If a stationary geometric structure near the frozen point has cavities or elastic modes that survive submergence or burial, active broadband acoustics may reveal a reproducible multi-mode spectral fingerprint distinguishable from matched natural controls.
hypothesis.music_translation: PYRAMID_MUSIC is operationalized as deterministic spectral coloration or ringing of an incident signal, not spontaneous sound generation.

survey_ladder.action: Measure scaled pyramid and non-pyramid controls in dry, sealed, flooded, partial and buried states with calibrated projector and at least 3 hydrophones.
survey_ladder.advance_if: fingerprint is repeatable and classifier separates pyramid controls from non-pyramid controls on blind holdout

survey_ladder.action: Search any available low-frequency sub-bottom, seismic and trackline data through the frozen point before requesting new field work.
survey_ladder.advance_if: direct acoustic or seismic line intersects the frozen point or preregistered buffer

survey_ladder.action: At frozen point run CTD, low-frequency sub-bottom or seismic, then broadband multi-aspect active acoustic sweep if environmental and legal conditions permit.
survey_ladder.advance_if: stationary subsurface reflector or resonant target repeats on at least 3 passes

survey_ladder.action: Solve acoustic target coordinates from navigation plus travel time and beam geometry and compare to frozen bisector coordinate.
survey_ladder.advance_if: residual and uncertainty ellipse are reported without moving the predicted point

bisector_calibration.forbidden: Do not modify LOVE or EDEM coordinates or bisector longitude or latitude to absorb a target residual.

controls: shipwreck or known manmade object if available
reject_conditions: feature appears only on gravity-predicted bathymetry
signal does not repeat on independent pass
candidate disappears after CTD sound-speed correction
template score is not better than matched natural controls
location requires recentering the frozen point
